title: Hanasato Minori — I'm Gonna Lose My Head!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Screaming?! Welcome to the Forest of Wolves!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whaaat?!
That wolf was actually Kohane?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, okay. She was just looking for her friend after they got scared and ran off...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're sorry that we couldn't keep her longer.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, that's okay. I mean, you were in the middle of your play, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Still... Where could Kohane and An have gone?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, what if you checked the neighboring classrooms?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
This may be just me, but...
If I were to become scared and run off somewhere, I'd probably find a nearby classroom to hide in.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that makes a lot of sense! Hmm... One of the neighboring classrooms...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And if I knew that someone there would help me, I'd be more inclined to seek them out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You made a light bulb go off in my head, Honami! Someone from a neighboring class who'd be willing to help!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I've gotta go!
Thanks again, you two!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And we'll let you know if we see them!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
Ugh... Why didn't I realize this sooner?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka's in Class 1-C, which is right there! She's known An forever, so this might be where she went!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I believe that's everything you have ordered.
Please enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: An came just a second ago, but left right after.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Probably because that zombie wolf came chasing after her.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I have a feeling that she didn't know Kohane was the one dressed as it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no... We need to let her know as soon as possible that this is all just a big mistake... Wait a second...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka, how did you know Kohane's the one who's dressed as the wolf?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Based on her voice.
I tried to ask her what was going on...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But our customers also became pretty startled. Some had their little children with them, so I had to...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hey, Wolfie!
I think you're in the wrong forest!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Shouldn't you be at Class 1-A?
Are you here to advertise your haunted house? It's called “Little Red Riding Hood and the Young Goats' Slightly Scary Forest Adventure”, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Class 1-A is doing a haunted house!
I-It's really fun, so we hope you'll stop by later!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-That's amazing, Haruka!
You're so good at thinking on your feet!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I actually need to thank Kohane for picking up on what I was doing so quickly.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, after that, she headed towards the AV Room to look for An...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait... I asked Aoyagi and Shinonome where they went and rushed towards the end of the corridor... What if I just missed them?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There are a lot of people here today, and a lot of signs and stuff lying around...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You'll probably have to keep a close eye out in order to find them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I've gotta find Kohane fast and get that mask off her head!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, can you wait here for a second?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, you brought some orange juice!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm guessing you're pretty thirsty after running around so much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're doing your best to help Kohane and An, so this one's on me...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
“Meow. You can do it, Minori.
I believe in you♪ Meow♪”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. We decided against talking like cats because some people in class felt too embarrassed by it, but I hope that made you feel a little better.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Better?! I thought my heart was going to burst out of my chest!!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, Haruka! In the name of your meow, I vow to find Kohane and An!
